regions.merged_text: "He that once sins, like him that slides on ice Goes swiftly down the slipery ways of vice. The conscience checks him, yet those rubs gone o'er He slides as smoothly, and looks back no more." "Like a wayword child when about to be washed, corrupt nature complains against reason." "If you may not practice the devotions you propose, then do more fervently what are permitted."
